mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (id, user_id, product_id, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.price, p.original_price, p.quality, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.status, p.seller_id, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.create_time, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM favorite f INNER JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f INNER JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
